title: Preserve the Dashboard datasource reference during v2 external export
answers: Why does a panel show Random Walk data after sharing and reimporting a dashboard?
How should v2 export handle the -- Dashboard -- datasource?
Preserve queries that reuse another panel’s results when sharing a dashboard
body:
Symptom: After exporting with “Share dashboard with another instance” and reimporting, a panel that reuses another panel’s results displays generated Random Walk data.
Root cause: public/app/features/dashboard-scene/scene/export/exporters.ts:makeExportableV2 treated the stable -- Dashboard -- reference as an instance-specific datasource UID and removed it.
Fix pattern: Preserve datasource.name equal to SHARED_DASHBOARD_QUERY with an early return before generating datasource-remapping labels or removing the reference.
Constraints: Applies to v2 external exports, including mixed queries and inlined library panels, with query group datasource or dashboard. Match the exact reference; ordinary datasource anonymization, other built-in datasources, migrations, and datasource resolution retain their existing behavior.
applies: V2 dashboard exports shared with another instance that contain Dashboard datasource queries.
